|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once per battle, may target opponent's smuggler present at same site. Target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn. Once during your control phase, may ▲ Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During battle, may cancel the game text of a smuggler present with Greedo for remainder of turn. During your control phase, may take one Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle?” '''What changed:''' “Once per” → “During”; “target opponent's” → “cancel the game text of a”; “at same site. Target's game text is canceled” → “with Greedo”; “Once during” → “During”; “▲” → “take one”; “Solo?.” → “Solo into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle?”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 34. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Greedo]].
* Later text: [[Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Greedo]].
